description: This bar chart illustrates the performance of two models, labeled “Ours (Iterative)” and an unnamed model, across several academic datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis represents the categories of datasets and metrics, labeled “GSM-8K”, “MMLU”, “HumanEval”, “TruthfulQA”, “ARC”, “MBPP”, “LC AlpacaEval-2”, “MT-Bench (x5)”, and “Chat-Arena-Hard”, listed in a non-alphabetical and non-descending order. The vertical axis, labeled “Score (%)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. For each dataset, there are two bars representing the two models; the unnamed model is represented by blue bars, and “Ours (Iterative)” is represented by orange bars. The shortest bars are for the unnamed model on “MMLU” and “HumanEval”, both reaching approximately 70%, while the tallest bar is for “Ours (Iterative)” on “MBPP”, reaching approximately 92%. The bars are arranged in pairs, with the unnamed model’s bar adjacent to “Ours (Iterative)” bar for each dataset, allowing for a visual comparison of performance. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
